The downloaded GLB is preserved without modification. Yunqi's free-model
preview normalizes its size and position, lights it, and offers optional
runtime jade recolouring of the authored fabric texture. The optional colour
adaptation is by this project. Original geometry, UVs, skin/face texture and
hair remain the creator's work; no original authorship is claimed here.

Actual inspected GLB: 6 meshes, 3 materials, 2 embedded PNGs,
282,516 triangles. It has no skins, joint weights or animation clips.
The source Blender download is separately described as rigged, but that
claim is not carried over to this GLB. It needs rigging before gameplay use.

This asset is currently a separate free-model review, not the game's active
character and not an accurate reconstruction of the user's reference.
Attribution must accompany any further redistribution of the original or
adapted work. No endorsement by the original creator is implied.
